sloka: आभिषेचनिकम् सर्वम् इदम् आदाय राघव ।प्रतीक्षते त्वाम् स्व जनः श्रेणयः च नृप आत्मज ॥२-७९-४॥
transliteration: ābhiṣecanikam sarvam idam ādāya rāghava ।pratīkṣate tvām sva janaḥ śreṇayaḥ ca nṛpa ātmaja ॥2-79-4॥

translations.english: O prince of the Raghu race (Bharata), your subjects and guilds of traders, artisans, etc, have procured necessary materials for your consecration, and await you.
